scope: Actual serial dispatcher and SDK memory-object/pool/reference/copy/critical code; standard0..6, all severities, hex8-byte chunking, empty/unknown types and reference release
limitations: Standard/hexdump formatters execute only in actual_formatter mode; printf/flush/calendar/color remain fixtures in that mode. No emitted byte stream or transport proof.
Timestamp is omitted by native two-word headers and disabled configuration; unused timestamp and structure padding are excluded from comparison.
Only valid bounded packets are tested; whole-image startup/linking, hardware and byte identity remain unresolved.
